authorship: assistant experiment and implementation; no new user prediction or authorship is inferred

motivation.interpretation: Repeated calls justify a bounded batch prototype. Short-kernel cost shares were not resolved by the prior periodic timer; no speedup is inferred from those samples.

hypothesis: Sharing int8 query sign extension across eight contiguous rows and reducing indirect calls may improve complete integer-distance scan efficiency. Register pressure, eager work and native AVX512 competition may erase the benefit.

reference.source: Immutable exported source, SHA256 plus Git blob independently replayed against formal-six-code-audit.json

execution.tooling_image: Adds Python3 through apt; actual image ID, build log and compiler version are retained. This is not a reproducible-package claim.
execution.actual_resource_gate: Docker inspect plus required cgroup files: quota=period>0, memory2147483648, swap0; before/selected affinity both requested singleCPU. Missing observations reject evidence.
execution.timeouts: 300s per command;20min workflow; failure logs retained; unsupported ISA is not a pass

correctness_before_timing.oracle: Independent uint64 exact sum for full int8 domain, additionally original AVX2/native dispatch.
coverage: invalid pointer/count/stride/overflow rejection and output sentinels
correctness_before_timing.limitation: The cap model is not the database float-bound or TopK implementation; no database correctness gate has been run.

fixed_measurement_plan.primary_comparison: same_isa_avx2: original row function pointer versus batch8 AVX2 function pointer
fixed_measurement_plan.optional_control: native_baseline_vs_avx2_batch only when original native dispatch selects AVX512; separately reported
fixed_measurement_plan.data: Full signed-int8 synthetic codes, mt19937 seed0x327a88, sequential generator across frozen group order; data/query creation outside timing. This is not the official or prior Gaussian DB distribution.
fixed_measurement_plan.warmup: Both complete scans run before four timed pairs for each group; same immutable corpus and checksums.
fixed_measurement_plan.timer: One CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID interval and one steady wall interval per whole scan, no per-distance timers.

frozen_screen_rules.scope: Eligibility to investigate DB integration only. No automatic adoption, official submission or score prediction.
frozen_screen_rules.identity_correctness_resources: Every source/binary/command/plan/response-checksum/correctness/resource check must be valid. Failure or missing evidence blocks interpretation.

primary_AVX2_128.groups: Both rows10000 and10003 separately; both wall and CPU separately

AVX2_512_guard.groups: Both rows10000 and10003 separately; wall and CPU separately

optional_AVX512_enablement_guard.groups: All four native-baseline control groups; both wall and CPU separately
optional_AVX512_enablement_guard.failure_action: Forbid replacing the native path on AVX512 hosts in any follow-up integration. An AVX2-only follow-up may be considered only if its primary and512 guards pass.

frozen_screen_rules.reporting: Keep all absolute pairs, negative ratios, order medians, memory/resource observations and failed/unsupported runs. Do not pool ISA arms or multiply micro ratios by prior EE/R results.
frozen_screen_rules.sampling: Four pairs per group provide a screening threshold, not statistical significance or independent confirmation.
frozen_screen_rules.stop_rule: No batch-size/seed/dimension/threshold tuning after results, no dropping adverse pairs. A genuine tool failure requires preserved evidence and a separately documented correction.
frozen_screen_rules.later_requirement: Any DB candidate must separately preserve current-cap row order/fallback, pass DB correctness and compare directly against highest EE plus retained R protection under a new preregistration and independent confirmation.

pre_push_line_ending_correction.scope: Checked workflow and gitattributes LF bytes; workflow was already LF, gitattributes changed CRLF to LF. Rules, source code and workload unchanged.
